entries.title: They Are Billions
entries.definitive_edition: They Are Billions on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current Steam release with campaign and Survival mode
primary.why: They Are Billions reached full PC release on June 18, 2019. Numantian later announced Xbox One and PlayStation 4 versions, but that console announcement explicitly described the initial console release as Survival mode only, with campaign mode planned for later. Because the Steam route is the clearest complete route with campaign, Survival mode, Workshop, level editor, and best capture/settings control, Windows PC is the archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release for full campaign and Survival coverage. Use console versions only after separately verifying campaign parity on the target storefront.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive edition split was found; keep console campaign-parity verification separate from the PC baseline.
